messages:
noah.t: FYI - audit picked up several invoices emitted this morning that have zero compute lines but the usage system shows GPU activity. Example: inv_00987x (velox). Noted duplicates for one invoice id where two PDFs were uploaded to S3.
sophie.g: Uh-oh. Which pipeline ran? new aggregator or scheduled nightly?
noah.t: Nightly run id: `nightly-2026-04-12-00z`. Logs show `emit_job` finishing before `usage-merge` completed. Snippet:
```
[00:01:10] emit_job: emitInvoice(inv_00987x) status=EMITTED total=420.00 line_item_count=1
[00:01:11] usage-merge: mergeUsage(inv_00987x) status=COMPLETE added_rows=4
```
That ordering looks reversed.
ray.p: billing-bot ran automated checks and flagged 12 invoices missing expected sku `compute.gpu`. Also flagged 2 invoices where pdf_service returned 200 twice for same invoice id.
billing-bot: Alerts: missing_sku_compute.gpu (12 ids), duplicate_pdf_s3_put (2 ids). Details -> s3://billing/alerts/1787654321/alert.json
zoe: Can we avoid customer-facing re-sends until we reconcile? If totals change we need approval. I propose: pause outbound-email for that nightly, run `billing:backfill --batch nightly-2026-04-12-00z --only-missing` then dry-run diff.
accounting: For any delta > $7,500 route to finance-approvals. Otherwise auto-approve after review. Please produce a CSV of invoice_id, old_total, new_total, delta.
sophie.g: I'll kick off dry-run now: `billingctl reconcile --batch nightly-2026-04-12-00z --dry --out /tmp/dry-1787654321.csv` and share results here.
noah.t: Dry-run launched at 1787654330. Preliminary: 12 affected; deltas range -$120 to +$9,800; one account (velox) shows +$9,800.
ray.p: For duplicates: looks like pdf-service got a retry after a 504 and ended up re-uploading. We'll add an idempotency key on S3 PUT and make pdf-service check invoice state before sending. I'll open a small patch.
zoe: Support should send a heads-up to velox if we will reissue an invoice with +$9.8k. Template draft in /docs/support/velox-reissue.md.
accounting: Approve automatic re-emit for items <= $7,500. velox needs manual sign-off. Once reconcile CSV posted, tagging finance-approvals.
sophie.g: Recon complete, uploaded: s3://billing/recons/dry-1787654321.csv. Summary: 11 invoices under threshold, 1 over (velox). All missing rows are compute.gpu or compute.reserved entries.
noah.t: Action items: 1) Pause email send for nightly-2026-04-12-00z (done). 2) Run backfill for missing rows `billingctl backfill --batch ... --apply --no-email` for invoices <= $7.5k. 3) Hold velox and submit to finance-approvals with supporting usage evidence.
ray.p: I'll queue pdf-service fix and roll a canary within the hour.
accounting: Once velox packet is in finance-approvals, I'll review. Keep this thread updated.
noah.t: Thanks all. I'll post the final CSV and the re-emit log when done.
